claims.source_quote_ar: تَقْدِيرُهُ: ذَلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَمْ يَكُ مُغَيِّرًا، وَبِأَنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ
claims.claim_ar: تقديره: «ذلك» قبل «إنّ» - أي تقدير العبارة «ذلك بأن الله...»
claims.claim_en: The clause is to be understood with an implied 'dhālika' ('that') before 'inna' (i.e., the meaning is 'that, because God did not change...').
The word 'اللَّهَ' is the ism (subject) of 'inna' and therefore in the accusative (mansūb).
The word 'عَلِيمٌ' is the predicate (khabar) of 'inna' and thus is nominative (marfūʿ).

claims.claim_ar: همزة «أنّ/إنّ» يجوز قراءتها مكسورة على الاستئناف (اختلاف قراءات في ضبط الحركة عند الوقف/الاستئناف).
claims.claim_en: The hamza of 'an/inn' may be read with a kasra on pausing (on isti'naf) — a reading variant affecting the vocalization of the particle.
claims.needs_review_reason: Reading-variant statement applies to forms of 'أنّ/إنّ' in the cited example; checking applicability to the exact orthography/pronunciation of this verse's 'فَإِنَّ' in different Qiraʾāt is recommended.
